bio_en: Huizhao continued Kuiji's interpretation of Yogācāra in the Chinese Faxiang tradition. His Lamp of Definitive Meaning defends that interpretation against competing readings of the Treatise Establishing Consciousness Only. Zhizhou carried on his commentarial work in the next generation. His death is commonly dated to 714, while an inscription-based reassessment cited by DILA places it between 726 and 741.
bio_summary: 慧沼承窺基法相唯識之學，著《成唯識論了義燈》辨諸家異義。後世奉為慈恩宗第二祖，智周承其學。
